latest_messages.headline: Pre-market plan · earnings test cleared — RMD, RSG & BP all beat · holding all 5, no new buys
latest_messages.body: The three holdings we were watching all reported good results: ResMed beat (GLP-1 confirmed as a tailwind), Republic Services beat and raised its forecast, and BP posted a big profit beat on strong refining (its one nitpick: no new buyback + a pre-flagged non-cash write-down). All three sit well above their safety nets. At the open I'm watching NOC (+4.6%, a hair under its +5% line) to switch it to a trailing stop. Market's in a cautious higher-rates mood (Dec Fed hike now expected). Sleeve full 5/5; ~$15.8k dry powder held. Weekly review this afternoon.
